discovery_notes: Corroboration pass for single-publisher DLR open edition pins. Several corroborating sources describe WDW or Disney Store releases of the same designs; release_location/price disagreements recorded as claims. Shared web-search budget ran out before 2026 batches (ice cream/rainbow swirl, Star Wars May 2026, July 2026 batch, Haunted Mansion glow, wedding rings, Christmas 2025, Villains booster) could be searched.
